## Theme name

The value users would pass to the `design` prop (e.g. `sunset`).

## Look and feel

Describe colours, backgrounds and mood. Link a mockup or reference if you have one.

## Checklist

- [ ] Styles scoped to `.auth-container.<theme>` in `frontend/src/components/AuthForm.css`
- [ ] Tested in both `signin` and `signup` modes, including error states and mobile widths
- [ ] Theme added to the `design` prop table in `README.md`
